enabled.description: A flag to enable or disable single Number Reach.

alertAllNumbersForClickToDialCallsEnable.description: Flag to enable alerting single number reach numbers for click to dial calls.

id.description: ID of Single number reach. Note that this ID contains base64 encoded phoneNumber data and can change if the phone number is modified.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number that will ring when a call is received. The number should be in E.164 format.

enabled.description: A flag to enable or disable this single Number Reach phone number.

name.description: Name of the single number reach phone number entry.

doNotForwardCallsEnabled.description: If enabled, the call forwarding settings of provided phone Number will not be applied.

answerConfirmationEnabled.description: If enabled, the call recipient will be prompted to press a key before being connected.

numbers.description: Array of single number reach number entries.
